apps.name: Séance
apps.summary: Connect to remote machines over SSH, with a file browser and optional encrypted sync.
apps.description: An SSH client with terminal sessions, stored server profiles, ProxyJump chains, a remote file browser and an optional session-aware assistant. Existing releases include desktop and Android builds plus an unsigned iOS artifact.

screenshots.alt: Séance SSH terminal and server browser

apps.name: Poltergeist
apps.summary: Browse and transfer files with a two-pane SFTP client.
apps.description: Local and remote file panes, queued transfers, bookmarks, synchronization and an integrated editor. Supports macOS, Windows, Linux and Android; install details and current platform limitations are documented in its existing repository.

apps.name: Planchette
apps.summary: Edit local text, configuration files and scripts with a focused desktop editor.
apps.description: Document tabs, find and replace, syntax highlighting, line numbers and guarded saves. Its editor foundation is also used by Séance and Poltergeist.
